author: Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar
text:
The satsang today had two talented youngsters showcasing their achievements!

A 9 year old polyglot recited verses, with their meanings, from the Bhagavad Gita, which he memorized when he was just 5. He is fluent in Hindi, English, Spanish, and Kannada, among others, with the ability to read and write 13 Indian scripts. He has also used AI to build a device that helps people learn the ancient text!

A 13 year old Intuition Process graduate demonstrated an app he built using AI in just 2 months that helps teenagers with studies, homework, getting tutored and building healthy habits.

author: Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar
text:
The name “Krishna” signifies absolute attraction. To overcome the illusions of the material world, one must find something far more captivating to focus on. Krishna is that ultimate attraction at every stage of life: a mischievous companion for children, a talented friend for the youth, a valiant hero for the courageous, “Yogeshwar” for seekers, a master strategist for leaders, and the source of ultimate wisdom for elders.

#HappyJanmashatami

Women standing up for themselves is bringing about a much-needed revolution. Men need to respect women, be more sensitive towards them and not objectify them. This sensitivity and respect must be instilled from the teenage years.
